Simulate published summary tables and UKHSA-style annual surveillance tables

Source: R/create_fake_data.R
create_fake_published_data.Rd

Generates synthetic aggregate tables matching the two most common forms of published TB literature and public health surveillance reports (without individual participant data):

  1. `summary_table`: Subgroup-level published summary table reporting group sample size (`n`), positive LTBI test count (`y`), cumulative active TB case count (`d`) over follow-up window `[0, t_horizon]`, and subgroup covariates.

  2. `interval_table`: Annual surveillance report table (e.g., UKHSA / ETS reports) giving active TB case counts (`d`) in annual intervals `[t_start, t_end]` (Year 0-1, 1-2, ..., `t_horizon`) out of an initial screened / migrant cohort (`n`).

Usage

create_fake_published_data(
  n_groups = 6,
  n_per_group = 500,
  n_surveillance = 4000,
  p_ltbi = 0.3,
  p_ltbi_surv = NULL,
  sens = 0.85,
  spec = 0.95,
  surv_dist = c("gompertz", "weibull", "exponential"),
  shape = -0.3,
  rate = 0.06,
  t_horizon = 5,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n_groups

Integer. Number of published demographic/clinical strata in `summary_table`. Default is `6`.

n_per_group

Integer. Sample size per group in `summary_table`. Default is `500`.

n_surveillance

Integer. Total denominator cohort size for the annual surveillance `interval_table`. Default is `4000`.

p_ltbi

Numeric in `(0, 1)`. True baseline LTBI prevalence in the published LTBI survey table. Default is `0.30`.

p_ltbi_surv

Numeric in `(0, 1)` or `NULL`. True LTBI prevalence in the surveillance progression cohort. Defaults to `p_ltbi` (set different to simulate conflict / under-reporting / case-mix shift between published surveys and routine surveillance).

sens

Numeric in `(0, 1]`. Diagnostic test sensitivity. Default `0.85`.

spec

Numeric in `(0, 1]`. Diagnostic test specificity. Default `0.95`.

surv_dist

Character. Uncured survival family: `"gompertz"`, `"weibull"`, or `"exponential"`.

shape

Numeric. Shape parameter for Gompertz or Weibull. Default `-0.3` (decaying progression hazard over years since entry).

rate

Numeric (`> 0`). Initial annual progression hazard rate `lambda`. Default `0.06`.

t_horizon

Integer (`>= 1`). Number of annual follow-up intervals. Default is `5`.

seed

Optional integer random seed.

Value

A list with `summary_table` (cumulative subgroup counts), `interval_table` (annual interval counts by time since entry), `prevalence_data` (aggregate survey totals), and `truth` (true parameters).
